justification: Critical: a production data load (migration 090, 16 SEPP Schedule 1 rules, applied) that the granny-flat tool now serves, plus a new CI gate on hand-typed planning figures that fails any PR adding one.

pre_impl.existing_data: housing_sepp_standards: 42 pathway-null rows before 090, 58 after. Schedule 1 cl 5-11 (height, road/side/rear setbacks, balconies, public reserve) had no rows; the tool typed approximations citing cl 4.18 and Sch 3.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Only zone codes had a hardcoded-data check; numeric figures had none, so a typed 450 m2 minimum reached six surfaces.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New lint copies lint_hardcoded_zone_codes.py's baseline shape. 090 rows use approval_pathway NULL like the existing Sch 1 rows (ids 36-45), so the path engine is untouched.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Quotes were taken from the SEPP (Housing) 2021 version in force from 11 Sep 2026 (browser-saved, 2026-10-09) and each traced with provenance_check.trace_row() before the file was written; the weekly check re-proves them.
pre_impl.frontend_type: sepp_standards gains 11 more standard types; the label is derived from standard_type, including its lot-area band.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Without 090 the tool shows no height or setback figures at all; with a typed table it shows figures nothing proves. The lint stops a new typed figure reaching users.

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_lint_hardcoded_regulatory_numbers.py tests/test_provenance_check.py tests/test_housing_sepp_standards_readers.py -q -o addopts= ; python scripts/lint_hardcoded_regulatory_numbers.py --baseline ; python scripts/outreach_claim_checks.py OC-6
falsifiable_check.fails_when: A typed planning figure is added anywhere in served code, or a 090 quote stops tracing to its clause.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Observed 2026-10-10: the lint's first version MISSED the old typed table (number and label in separate strings); the test failed, the check was widened, and it now finds 10 typed figures in the pre-#1245 GrannyFlatTool including 450 m2 and 8.5 m. It also caught this PR's own typed band labels (7 -> 16), which were then derived from the rule names (16 -> 1). 67 of 67 quoted SEPP rows trace; OC-6 holds at 58.

functions.name: hits_in_text
functions.input: the text of one served source file read from the working tree
functions.output: every string literal on a line that holds a planning number with a unit beside a planning word
functions.if_none: An empty list; comment lines and lines marked noqa: regulatory-number are skipped.

functions.name: seppStandardLabel
functions.input: a stored standard_type such as setback_side_lot_450_to_900 from the check route
functions.output: a display label with the lot-area band parsed from the stored name
functions.if_none: An unknown type falls back to its raw name; no figure is invented.

values.value: 16 Schedule 1 figures (8.5 m height, 4.5/6.5/10 m road, 2/3/5 m corner, 9 m classified road, 0.9/1.5/2.5 m side, 3/5/10 m rear, 12 m2 balconies, 3 m public reserve)
values.source: SEPP (Housing) 2021 Schedule 1 cl 5-11, epi-2021-0714, quoted per row
values.read_at: each canibuildit check and every SEPP reader
values.if_missing: The tool hides the card or shows the unavailable notice; never a typed figure.

queries.where_clause: development_type = 'secondary_dwelling' AND standard_type IN (...) AND numeric_value IS NOT NULL AND source_quote IS NOT NULL

break_it.scenario: A typed planning figure is added to served code
break_it.what_happens: CI fails naming the file and the rise

break_it.scenario: A figure is split across two strings (label in one, value in another)
break_it.what_happens: Still caught: the planning word is matched on the whole line
break_it.how: line-level planning-word match, proven on the old typed SEPP table

break_it.scenario: The SEPP is amended and a Schedule 1 figure changes
break_it.what_happens: The weekly provenance check names the rule whose quote no longer matches
break_it.how: every 090 row has an anchored link and quote that trace_row checks

break_it.scenario: Migration 090 is run a second time against a database that already holds these rules
break_it.what_happens: It refuses before inserting anything, because the standard types already exist in the table

break_it.scenario: The published SEPP standards count on the site drifts from the live table again
break_it.what_happens: OC-6 fails CI and the nightly data check
break_it.how: coverage.ts set to the live 58 in the same PR

break_it.scenario: The tool standards query (tool standards incl. Schedule 1) fails or returns no rows
break_it.what_happens: The tool shows the 'could not be loaded' notice or hides the card, never a typed figure

post_merge.manual_verify: Migration 090 is already applied (16 rows). After deploy, the granny-flat tool should show height and setback rows linked to Schedule 1 clauses.

real_layer_exempt.migrations/090_sepp_housing_schedule1_gr: Applied to production 2026-10-10 after a rolled-back dry run (16 rows); all 67 quoted SEPP rows re-traced against the law in force.
